title: CHAPTER 023 - Read-only diagnosis of 022 loop and runner state
description: Whole automated diagnostic chapter. READ/EVIDENCE captures state, log tail, runner/helper processes, 022 helper/report, recent 022 run directories and local runner hashes/syntax. CONCLUSION emits compact markers only. No runner switch, no process stop, no state mutation, no configuration change.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=Join-Path $root ('backups\023\'+$stamp); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null; foreach($name in @('3en-agent.state.json','3en-agent.log','chapter-022-v36-handover.txt','switch-to-v36-022.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1')){$src=Join-Path $root $name;if(Test-Path $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $bk $name) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_023_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'chapter-023-diagnosis.txt'; Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('=== CHAPTER 023 DIAGNOSIS ===',('START='+(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))); Write-Host '=== READ / EVIDENCE ==='; Write-Host '--- STATE ---'; $stateFile=Join-Path $root '3en-agent.state.json'; if(Test-Path $stateFile){$stateRaw=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host $stateRaw; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('--- STATE ---',$stateRaw)}else{Write-Host 'STATE_FILE=MISSING'; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value 'STATE_FILE=MISSING'}; Write-Host '--- LOG TAIL 120 ---'; $logFile=Join-Path $root '3en-agent.log'; if(Test-Path $logFile){$logTail=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $logFile -Tail 120 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $logTail|ForEach-Object{Write-Host $_}; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('--- LOG TAIL 120 ---')+$logTail}else{Write-Host 'LOG_FILE=MISSING'}; Write-Host '--- PROCESSES ---'; $ps=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*switch-to-v36-022.ps1*') } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate,CommandLine); if($ps.Count -eq 0){Write-Host 'MATCHING_PROCESS_COUNT=0'}else{$ps|Format-List|Out-String|Write-Host}; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('--- PROCESSES ---',($ps|Format-List|Out-String)); Write-Host ('MATCHING_PROCESS_COUNT='+$ps.Count); Write-Host '--- 022 REPORT ---'; $r22=Join-Path $root 'chapter-022-v36-handover.txt'; if(Test-Path $r22){$r22raw=Get-Content -LiteralPath $r22 -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host $r22raw; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('--- 022 REPORT ---',$r22raw)}else{Write-Host 'REPORT_022=MISSING'}; Write-Host '--- 022 HELPER ---'; $h22=Join-Path $root 'switch-to-v36-022.ps1'; if(Test-Path $h22){$h22raw=Get-Content -LiteralPath $h22 -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host $h22raw; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('--- 022 HELPER ---',$h22raw); $ht=$null;$he=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($h22,[ref]$ht,[ref]$he)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('HELPER_022_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($he).Count)}else{Write-Host 'HELPER_022=MISSING'}; Write-Host '--- RUNNERS ---'; foreach($name in @('3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1')){$p=Join-Path $root $name;if(Test-Path $p){$hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;$t=$null;$e=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($p,[ref]$t,[ref]$e)|Out-Null;Write-Host ($name+'_SHA256='+$hash);Write-Host ($name+'_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($e).Count)}else{Write-Host ($name+'=MISSING')}}; Write-Host '--- RECENT 022 RUNS ---'; $runs=Join-Path $root 'runs'; if(Test-Path $runs){$dirs=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $runs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -like '*2026-09-09-022*'} | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 10); Write-Host ('RUN_022_DIR_COUNT='+$dirs.Count); foreach($d in $dirs){Write-Host ('RUN_DIR='+$d.FullName+' LASTWRITE='+$d.LastWriteTime.ToString('s')); $files=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d.FullName -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); foreach($f in $files){Write-Host ('  FILE='+$f.Name+' SIZE='+$f.Length)}}}; Write-Host '=== CONCLUSION MARKERS ==='; $stateText=''; if(Test-Path $stateFile){$stateText=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}; Write-Host ('STATE_HAS_022='+($stateText -match '2026-09-09-022')); $v35=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1*'}); $v36=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'}); $hh=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*switch-to-v36-022.ps1*'}); Write-Host ('ACTIVE_V35_COUNT='+$v35.Count); Write-Host ('ACTIVE_V36_COUNT='+$v36.Count); Write-Host ('ACTIVE_HELPER_022_COUNT='+$hh.Count); Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('=== CONCLUSION MARKERS ===',('STATE_HAS_022='+($stateText -match '2026-09-09-022')),('ACTIVE_V35_COUNT='+$v35.Count),('ACTIVE_V36_COUNT='+$v36.Count),('ACTIVE_HELPER_022_COUNT='+$hh.Count),('END='+(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_023_READONLY_DIAGNOSIS=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY CHAPTER: no rollback required; only backup copies and diagnostic report were created.'
